From: Tomás Echeverría <tomas.echeverria@cordillerainversiones.example>
Sent: Thursday, November 5, 2026 1:20 PM
To: Pat Staffer <pat@yourcompany.com>
Subject: Financing proposal - Miami subsidiary
 

Dear Mr. Staffer,

Further to our call, I confirm that our board approved the purchase of the two units for our Miami subsidiary. We would like to receive your financing proposal in USD.

Best regards,

 

Tomás Echeverría
Gerente de Finanzas Corporativas
Inversiones Cordillera S.A.
Av. Apoquindo 3000, Piso 12
Las Condes, Santiago
Chile
